1) I’ll share our DPA draft and SCC guide by EOD tomorrow (attached).

3) Rishi and I will coordinate any redlines with legal and loop in Neha for security-specific questions.

Please confirm that Module 2 is the preferred SCC route on your side and whether Acme will act as Controller for the data processed by Redwood.

Thanks — talk soon.
